24:28.text: And if you find no one therein, still, enter not until permission has been given. And if you are asked to go back, go back, for it is purer for you. And Allâh is All-Knower of what you do.

24:29.text: There is no sin on you that you enter
you have any interest in them. And Allâh has knowledge of what you reveal and what you conceal.

24:30.text: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze
. That is purer for them. Verily, Allâh is All-Aware of what they do.

24:31.text: And tell the believing women to lower their gaze
and not to show off their adornment except only that which is apparent
(like both eyes for necessity to see the way, or outer palms of hands or one eye or dress like veil, gloves, head-cover, apron, etc.)
, and to draw their veils all over Juyûbihinna
(i.e. their bodies, faces, necks and bosoms)

and not to reveal their adornment except to their husbands, or their fathers, or their husband’s fathers, or their sons, or their husband’s sons, or their brothers or their brother’s sons, or their sister’s sons, or their

slaves whom their right hands possess, or old male servants who lack vigour, or small children who have no sense of feminine sex. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And all of you beg Allâh to forgive you all, O believers, that you may be successful.
